statement: WiiBrew's IR Camera Data Formats section specifies extended mode as three bytes per tracked point with 10-bit coordinates and a 4-bit size, and full mode as nine bytes per point including four 7-bit bounding fields, reserved data and an 8-bit intensity field. Its description confirms packet-field meanings but does not establish a calibrated physical intensity-to-light relationship. Dolphin uses a synthetic geometric approximation, so retail intensity fidelity remains unknown.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 123257 sections IR Camera / Data Formats / Extended Mode and Full Mode; Dolphin Camera.h 65-101 / cpp 139-170, no tables or captured data.
